observed.opening: Full-frame snowy terrain, centered luminous igloo, sparse corner text, lower-left scroll prompt and Sound: Off. Animated blocks and numeric tracers sit in scene space.
observed.typography: IBM Plex Mono Medium identified by public resource metadata; tight small mono interface with bold custom logo.
observed.motion: Floating blocks and scattered snow continue while text glitches resolve; camera framing changes slightly between captures.
observed.density: Most screen area belongs to terrain and hero object. UI occupies corners, leaving central composition unobstructed.
observed.load: Visible loader persisted about 30 seconds; WebGL2 supported, no page errors or failed requests recorded.
observed.accessibility: No light-DOM text, controls or canvas found by document queries after screenshot capture; visual sound control exists but semantic keyboard operation was not verified.

limits: Four opening/native-scroll captures and four wheel-driven captures were visually inspected.
Large individual wheel deltas did not advance beyond animated igloo opening within bounded capture time. Portfolio/footer camera progression and transition timing were not observed.
Maker case study was successfully read in Firefox after web fetch timed out.
No website source, models, textures or audio were copied.

makerStatements.previs: Grey mockups and untextured camera animations establish journey before detail.
makerStatements.intro: Real-time intro blends into rest of experience.
makerStatements.transitions: Chromatic aberration, tech displacement and frost.
makerStatements.objects: Unique ice silhouettes keep successive projects distinct.
makerStatements.footer: Particles form models for selected external links.
makerStatements.ui: WebGL SDF text supports glitches and scrambling.

proposedForStranded: One continuous camera route: falling silhouette above island; lowered wake shot; close eye aperture; orbit toward glowing quantum mind.
Use ocular blackout, fog occlusion and short bloom peaks to bridge camera shots; hold quiet compositions between transitions.
Keep rain/fog/sea motion ambient; localize neon to the mind and a few signs.
Place scene identity, one short story cue, mute and progress controls at edges. Keep primary controls in semantic DOM.
Give each narrative beat a distinct silhouette and camera distance.
doNotReuse: Igloo branding, logo, manifesto, numerical labels, ice forms, models, shaders or media.
Full-WebGL-only text/control strategy without independently verified accessible equivalents.
Long blank loader or continuous glitch on reading text.
